_comment: MLV-App documentation size budgets, read by the fleet's canonical check-doc-size (bus tools/factory/check-doc-size.py) run BY PIN. This file replaces the CONFIG block of the retired tools/check-doc-size.py (CHECK-DOC-SIZE-SINGLE-SOURCE-1). Run: py -3 tools/docs/run_doc_size.py --warn-only --all. Policy of record: docs/22-doc-fragmentation-policy.md.

entry.why: auto-loaded by an agent on every cold session; every byte taxes every session

hub.why: multi-lane coordination ledgers; re-read on every seat rotation (ratified 150 KB, .claude-state/coordination/COORDINATION-PRUNE-POLICY.md, BINDING 2026-07-15); one trigger, so soft == hard on purpose

ledger.why: append-only; the live head is capped and the tail rotates to a dated archive

working.why: read in full by one lane when it picks the item up

_exempt: Exempt by policy, not by oversight. The bus tool matches plain fnmatch, so a leading '**/' (which the retired local tool also let match at the repo root) is spelled twice: with and without the prefix.
_exempt_ignored: The last four entries exist only because 'worktree' scanning also sees git-ignored files outside .claude-state, which the retired tool (git-tracked + a .claude-state walk) never governed: .codex-state/ (.gitignore:101, regenerable lane state), CLAUDE_CODE_PROMPTS.md (.gitignore:70) and the two pytest caches outside .claude-state (a cache under .claude-state stays governed, as it was). Listing them keeps the finding set identical to the retired tool's.
_scan: 'worktree' (walk the checkout, untracked and git-ignored included) is deliberate: .claude-state is git-ignored and is 58% of this repo's markdown mass, so a git-tracked scan would report compliance while the hottest files sat outside it. It also never decodes git output, so a non-ASCII file name is walked as the str os.walk yields (the bus tool's git-tracked mode decodes `git ls-files` with the locale codec: airmypc/factory-check-doc-size-drops-non-ascii-paths).
_skip_dirs: Pruned at any depth by the walk. 'worktrees' keeps the walk out of the untracked full repo copies (.gitignore) that the exempt list already excludes; the rest is the retired tool's WALK_SKIP.
remedy: Over the hard cap -> demote the file to an index IN PLACE and move
the detail into children. Do NOT rename the parent: every existing
link and pinned string must keep resolving.
